name: Thirty-One (Greek)
description: Thirty-One (often called '31' or 'H τριανταμία' in Greek) is a simple draw-and-discard game popular in Greece and worldwide. Players try to collect a hand of three cards in the same suit totaling 31 points (Ace=11, Face=10). The player with the lowest score loses a life.
origin: Europe (possibly France or Germany, very popular in Greece)

overview.description: Thirty-One (often called '31' or 'H τριανταμία' in Greek) is a simple draw-and-discard game popular in Greece and worldwide. Players try to collect a hand of three cards in the same suit totaling 31 points (Ace=11, Face=10). The player with the lowest score loses a life.
overview.origin: Europe (possibly France or Germany, very popular in Greece)

history.origins: One of the oldest European card games, dating back to the 15th century (Trentuno).
timeline: 15th century: Trentuno and related 31 games attested in Europe; spread to France, England, Ireland and popular in Greece.
history.cultural: Often played in cafes or social gatherings in Greece.
history.evolution: Remains largely unchanged. Popular in Greece as a casual social game.

setup.dealing: Deal 3 cards to each player. Place one card face up (or three) to start discard pile.

rules.objective: Get a hand totaling 31 points in one suit, or have a higher score than the lowest player.
rules.gameplay: Turn: Draw one card from Stock or Discard pile, then discard one card. Try to improve suit sum. Knocking: If a player thinks they have high enough score, they knock. Everyone else gets one last turn. Scoring: A=11, K/Q/J=10, Num=Face. 3 of a kind (30pts) is a special rule in some variants.
keyRules: Suits matters (points must be same suit)

strategy.basic: Pick a suit and stick to it. Trade low cards for high ones. Knock if you have >25 points early.
strategy.intermediate: Watch what opponents pick up to guess their suit. If someone picks up a Spade, don't discard high Spades.
strategy.advanced: Defensive knocking: Knock early to catch opponents with mixed suits, even if your score is mediocre (e.g., 20-22).
tips: Three of a kind (30) is often a valid hand.
Don't hold onto two suits for too long.

scoring.description: Lowest score loses a life. If doing 31 exactly (Blitz), round ends immediately and everyone else loses a life.
scoring.winCondition: Get a hand totaling 31 points in one suit, or have a higher score than the lowest player.
